 Cardiff City rally late against Burnley as Robertson strikes in added time 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Match in Five Sentences: 
Cardiff City beat Burnley 5-4 at the Cardiff City Stadium. Andréas Hountondji put Burnley ahead in the 15th minute from Lucas Pires ' through ball. Marcus Edwards doubled the lead (25.), and after the break Largie Ramazani made it three (55.) before an Alex Robertson own goal left Cardiff 4-1 down (62.), but substitute Yousef Salech sparked the fightback with a strike (65.), then won a penalty that Jack Moylan converted (75.) and headed the equaliser (82.). Alex Robertson won it for Cardiff in the fourth minute of second half stoppage time, and the hosts finished with 66% possession that underpinned their surge. Cardiff rise from 16th to 14th and visit Norwich next, while The Clarets remain 22nd and host Blackburn next.
 Player of the Match: 
Yousef Salech transformed the game off the bench, scoring twice, winning the penalty for Jack Moylan, and converting both of his attempts on target.
 OneFootball Videos
 Stat of the Match: 
Cardiff City produced 11 shots on target from 25 attempts, sustained pressure behind the turnaround.
 Three Things We Learned: 
Rubin Colwill created relentlessly, delivering two assists and five key passes. The Clarets posted a 53.3% shot accuracy from 15 attempts to build a big lead. Nathan Trott made five saves, crucial interventions that kept Cardiff alive before their late surge.
